div.div:
Notes
*1 Security groups for AWS resources
SG app allows egress only to 443 on the S3 prefix list and 8080 on the server's SG. S3 Access Points worked; 443 and 2049 to the SVM did not. The same held for an isolated pod.
*2 NetworkPolicy between Pods
The server accepts 8080 only from role=client. A Pod with no SecurityGroupPolicy was stopped by the server's SG even though the NetworkPolicy allowed it.
*3 Trident PVs are outside the Pod's SG
The node mounts NFS. A Pod whose SG allows no egress still wrote to its PV.
*4 Scope
2026-11-12, ap-northeast-1a, one observation each. Pod icons are Kubernetes community icons (Apache-2.0).
